name: hotline
description: Cross-workspace Claude Code communication. Dial another workspace to ask questions, delegate work, or collaborate in real-time.

interface.longDescription: Give your agents a phone. Dial another Claude Code workspace to ask a quick question, hand off an autonomous work order, or collaborate back-and-forth — with a live switchboard dashboard of every call.
defaultPrompt: Use $hotline:hotline-dial to call another workspace with a question or work order.
Use $hotline:hotline-add-contact to register this workspace so others can reach it.
Use $hotline:hotline-switchboard to watch cross-workspace conversations live.
